acceptance_note: Accepted only as an isolated experimental implementation; no promotion. All five grouped intervals and per-position medians must be positive; correctness gates are required independently.
method: Paired repetitions within each FEN/control. Primary search statistic: geometric mean of per-position median paired wall-NPS ratios. Hierarchical 95% bootstrap resamples 12 positions and paired repeats within each sampled position, 10,000 draws, fixed seed; descriptive for this fixed fixture suite. Repetitions are not independent chess positions.
